a-retirement-is-two-edits.description: retiring a file from this configuration is two edits — the source file goes and its deployed target path is listed in home/.chezmoiremove — and the retirement is proven at the target path, never at the source or by an apply's exit code

astra-uses-the-codex-subscription-hop.description: Astra is available to LiteLLM-compatible agents through the saved Codex Pro login, with an explicit subscription pin
astra-uses-the-codex-subscription-hop.read_when: using Astra with another agent or maintaining the ChatGPT bridge

tests-and-gates-retire.description: tests/ and gates/ are deleted and the configs are stripped of their board scaffolding — this tree is one person's dev setup, not a shipped product
tests-and-gates-retire.read_when: adding a test or a gate, or asking where tests/ went

the-manual-is-markdown.description: the fumadocs site is deleted and the manual becomes plain markdown shipped with the shell, searched line by line through a television channel bound to `?`
the-manual-is-markdown.read_when: touching the manual, or asking why there is no docs site

the-model-router-is-a-dotfile-after-all.description: the model router lives in home/ as one binary plus a registry; the 2026-09-02 answer that moved it to its own project is reversed
the-model-router-is-a-dotfile-after-all.read_when: touching the llm router, or asking where it lives

the-record-is-memos.description: the record is memos/ — the board's memos, wiki, graphify vault and grammar fold into it, the PRD board survives, git is the archive
the-record-is-memos.read_when: asking where a memo, a wiki note or a graphify file went

tmux-owns-multiplexing.description: tmux takes windows, panes, addressing and scrollback so the config survives a restart and follows an ssh; WezTerm keeps only what is local to this machine
tmux-owns-multiplexing.read_when: touching the multiplexer, tmux.conf or wezterm.lua

worker-knowledge-lands-here.description: worker knowledge lands on this repo's record, not on another board's — every record is resolved from where the work is, never from where the script lives
worker-knowledge-lands-here.read_when: dispatching workers, or recording a worker's finding
